a=0,b=1 and a=1,b=0; both sub values and both signedness values.

Comparator: signedness, equality and one-hot outputs
a=7FFFFFFF,b=80000000; toggle unsigned_mode. Also include an equal pair.
Signed: gt=1; unsigned: lt=1. Equal operands: eq=1. Exactly one of eq,lt,gt is asserted.
Shifter: logical directions and shift boundaries
a=12345678; mode=00 then 01; shamt sweeps 0..31. Show 0,1,31.
Amount 0 preserves input. At amount 1: SRL=091A2B3C,SLL=2468ACF0. At amount 31 both outputs are zero for this input.
Shifter: arithmetic sign fill and reserved mode
a=FEDCBA98; compare SRL and SRA; include reserved mode=11.
At amount 1: SRL=7F6E5D4C,SRA=FF6E5D4C. At amount 31 SRA=FFFFFFFF. Reserved mode always outputs zero.
ALU: arithmetic, bitwise and unused encodings
All ten documented opcodes match the reference. For the alternating-bit pair XOR=FFFFFFFF,OR=FFFFFFFF,AND=00000000. Opcodes A..F return zero.
ALU: SLT/SLTU and low-five-bit shift masking
Compare 7FFFFFFF with 80000000. Shift FEDCBA98 by b=20 hex and 12345678 by b=3F hex.
SLT=0,SLTU=1 with bits31:1 zero. b=20 hex means shift 0; b=3F hex means shift 31.
Register file: asynchronous reset after nonzero writes
Assert rstn low at 23251ns between clock edges, after the register-write sweep.
Selected read values clear at reset assertion without waiting for a rising edge; the subsequent address sweep verifies every register is zero.
Register file: edge write, two read ports, x0 and write disable
Write x0 then x1..x31 with CAFE0000|index; later disable writes and change read addresses.
x0 remains zero; no write forwarding before the edge; the written value appears after the edge. Both reads follow addresses asynchronously; disabled writes preserve contents.
Async memory: masks and little-endian byte lanes
Masks 0..F at offsets 0..3; select focused panels for 1,2,4,8,F. Final valid write: addr=207F,wdata=01020304,mask=F.
Only enabled lanes change at the edge; mask=0 preserves data. Word 01020304 has bytes 04,03,02,01 at ascending addresses 207C..207F.
Async memory: range checks and unchanged data after invalid writes
Last valid address=207F; invalid addresses=203F,2080,20C0,0,FFFFFFFF; then read back all valid words.
Invalid reads return zero; invalid writes do not alias valid words. 207F accesses the last word; all valid readbacks match the model.
Sync memory: enabled read and disabled-read hold
Initial writes with rden=0, followed by enabled reads and generated accesses with rden=0.
sync_data updates only after a rising edge with rden=1, holds when rden=0, and becomes zero after an enabled out-of-range read.
At addr=2040, old word=1234AB00; wdata=DEADBEEE,mask=1,wren=rden=1 at the 23505ns rising edge.
After the edge async_data=1234ABEE, but sync_data=1234AB00. The next enabled read returns the updated word: read-before-write.
Both memories: minimum size and top-of-address-space boundary
Separate one-word instances: START_ADDR=FFFFFFFC,ADDR_WIDTH=2. Write 89ABCDEF through FFFFFFFF; try writing address 0; read FFFFFFFC.
The top word stores 89ABCDEF. Address 0 is invalid and cannot wrap into it; enabled invalid reads return zero, then the original word is read back intact.
